text: Claudictive is an Overwolf in-game overlay that opens a Claude Code session over the running game at the press of a hotkey, so a gamer-developer can talk to Claude without leaving the game.
The founder's bet: gamers want to work with Claude in the heat of the match, at the press of a button, without alt-tabbing out.
The closed beta has a few dozen installs from Israeli developer and gamer communities; weekly active usage dropped sharply after the first week.
source: beta install and usage dashboard (synthetic demo)

text: Low usage is probably caused by missing features (voice input, themes, a smaller window) rather than by the core use case; this has not been checked with users.
Twelve beta users agreed to a 15-25 minute interview about their use of Claudictive.
